proves.claim: A closure-budget row's headroom is max(5, ceil(5% of its ceiling)), and the over-ceiling message names each module the change added, capped at 40.

cli.journeys-imports-closure-budget.head.why: Without it, a row at main's exact count would red every unrelated item that adds one import, and a real trip would not say which modules it added.

proves.claim: A row measured on main's tree copied from the merge base through a private index names the repo-relative modules the change added, and no ref, index or worktree of the checkout changes.

cli.journeys-imports-closure-budget.adde.why: Without it, the added-module list could read the wrong tree or move the checkout's refs or index while measuring.
